Process customer and supplier invoices, monitor cash flow, and perform regular account reconciliations. Support month-end and year-end closings, budget tracking, and financial reporting. This full-time role requires a strong technical engineering background combined with hands-on procurement experience within the construction and contracting industry, specifically for finishing and fit-out projects. The successful candidate will be instrumental in ensuring the timely procurement of compliant materials and services. Role Overview The Senior Technical Engineer will be responsible for evaluating technical requirements, reviewing engineering drawings and specifications, and managing the technical aspects of procurement. This position involves close coordination with project and engineering teams to ensure all procurement activities align with project needs and quality standards. The role also includes managing suppliers, evaluating technical and commercial offers, and recommending cost-effective solutions without compromising quality. Key Responsibilities Manage and coordinate technical procurement activities for construction, finishing, and fit-out projects. Review engineering drawings, Bills of Quantities (BOQs), technical specifications, and material requirements before initiating procurement. Handle the complete procurement cycle, including supplier sourcing, Requests for Quotation (RFQs), technical and commercial evaluation, negotiations, and purchase order coordination. Identify, evaluate, and prequalify suppliers and subcontractors based on technical compliance, quality, cost, and delivery capabilities. Evaluate construction and finishing materials to ensure compliance with approved specifications, drawings, and project requirements. Review technical material submittals, samples, and product specifications, and coordinate consultant approvals. Coordinate with Engineering, Design, Project Management, and Site teams to ensure procurement requirements are properly defined and delivered on time. Review structural, architectural, and related technical requirements, identifying design or construction constraints that may affect procurement and execution. Recommend alternative materials and value-engineering solutions to optimize cost while maintaining technical standards and quality. Monitor procurement schedules, material approvals, purchase orders, and supplier delivery commitments. Resolve material shortages, supplier delays, technical discrepancies, and procurement-related project issues. Coordinate material inspections and testing with relevant project and quality teams. Prepare procurement status reports and update stakeholders on material requirements, approvals, and delivery progress. Ensure compliance with company procedures, project specifications, quality standards, and HSE requirements. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in technical engineering and procurement. Demonstrated practical experience in completed finishing and fit-out projects, preferably within Saudi Arabia. Strong technical engineering background combined with hands-on procurement experience in the construction and contracting industry. Ability to manage suppliers, evaluate technical and commercial offers, and recommend cost-effective solutions. Location and Work Type This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

Commitment to adhering to all safety protocols and operational guidelines. Work Environment This is a contract position based in either Riyadh or Taif. d4983219c9915d2f.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة جاز العربية للخدمات عن مهندس إلكتروني أجهزة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الجبيل، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تنفيذ وصيانة الأجهزة الإلكترونية، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص ومعالجة الأعطال لضمان الأداء الأمثل. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ خطط صيانة الأجهزة الإلكترونية ومتابعة إجراءات الصيانة، بما في ذلك التشغيل التجريبي والضبط بعد الصيانة. تشخيص أعطال الأجهزة الإلكترونية وتحديد القطع التي تتطلب التغيير أو الإصلاح، وإجراء الفحوصات اللازمة لضمان دقة الأداء. تطبيق برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة الإلكترونية وفقًا لتعليمات الشركة المصنعة ومتابعة تنفيذها. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بنتائج الأعمال، والمشاركة في عرضها وتوضيحها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقًا للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تشخيص أعطال الأجهزة الإلكترونية ومعالجتها بفعالية. معرفة ببرامج الصيانة الوقائية وإجراءات التشغيل. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة جاز العربية للخدمات في الجبيل، المنطقة الشرقية. يتطلب الدور التزامًا بالعمل الميداني والتقني لضمان استمرارية وكفاءة الأجهزة الإلكترونية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال عملية التوظيف. التقديم ندعو المهندسين الإلكترونيين المؤهلين لتقديم طلباتهم لهذا الدور في شركة جاز العربية للخدمات.

d400057b1ed51ced.description: About the Role The Arab Energy Fund is seeking a Senior Manager Accounting Reporting & Controls to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is critical for ensuring the integrity, accuracy, and compliance of the Fund’s financial accounting and reporting, aligning with IFRS, accounting policies, and regulatory requirements. Key Responsibilities Ensure the integrity, accuracy, and compliance of financial accounting and reporting through effective application of IFRS, accounting policies, and regulatory requirements. Provide technical accounting expertise and guidance on complex financial transactions, accounting estimates, and emerging IFRS requirements. Oversee statutory financial statements and regulatory reporting to the Central Bank of Bahrain (CBB), ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timely submission. Establish and maintain a robust financial control environment, including central financial controls, business-level controls, and Internal Controls over Financial Reporting (ICFR). Oversee the application of IFRS and accounting policies for accurate and consistent recognition, measurement, and presentation of financial transactions. Review significant accounting estimates, judgments, provisions, and adjustments for compliance with applicable accounting standards. Prepare and review technical accounting memoranda, position papers, and assessments of new or amended accounting standards. Oversee the integrity of accounting records, general ledger balances, and financial closing processes. Coordinate with stakeholders and external auditors to resolve accounting issues and ensure consistent policy application. Lead the preparation and review of interim and annual financial statements in accordance with IFRS and statutory requirements. Manage external audit activities, including deliverables, technical discussions, and timely resolution of findings. Develop, implement, and maintain an effective financial control framework covering Finance activities, business processes, and financial reporting. Oversee key financial controls such as general ledger reconciliations, journal approvals, account ownership, segregation of duties, and financial closing controls. Lead the development and implementation of the ICFR framework, including risk and control matrices and control documentation. Monitor control deficiencies, reconciliation exceptions, and audit observations, ensuring timely remediation. Develop, maintain, and periodically review accounting policies, procedures, and guidelines in accordance with IFRS and regulatory requirements. Identify and implement opportunities to improve the efficiency, accuracy, and effectiveness of accounting, reporting, and control processes. Act as a key technical accounting and financial control adviser to internal stakeholders. Manage and develop team capabilities through coaching, knowledge sharing, and performance management. Support the Financial Controller in delivering departmental objectives and strengthening financial governance. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of relevant experience in banking, financial services, or investment institutions. Demonstrated expertise in IFRS and financial reporting. Proven experience in establishing and maintaining financial control environments. Required Skills Strong technical accounting knowledge. Ability to provide guidance on complex financial transactions. Excellent coordination and communication skills with internal and external stakeholders. Leadership and team development capabilities. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within the financial services sector, specifically banking, financial services, or investment institutions. Application Process Candidates who meet the qualifications are encouraged to apply for this role to contribute to the financial governance of The Arab Energy Fund.

d405ea264fc0d2f7.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة محفوظ المميز الرئيسي للتجارة عن بائع للانضمام إلى فريقها في أحد المسارحة، جازان. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية بيع مجموعة من السلع والخدمات للعملاء، وتقديم معلومات مفصلة عن المنتجات، بالإضافة إلى إدارة عمليات الدفع والمخزون. يهدف الدور إلى ضمان تجربة تسوق سلسة للعملاء والحفاظ على ترتيب المتجر. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية بيع مجموعة متنوعة من السلع والخدمات للعملاء. توفير معلومات دقيقة وشاملة حول المنتجات، استخداماتها، وأسعارها. مراقبة مستويات المخزون بانتظام والحفاظ على ترتيب المتجر. إصدار طلبات شراء المنتجات الجديدة والتعامل مع المنتجات الواردة. تولي أمور الدفع وتلقي المدفوعات من العملاء، ومعالجة طلبات استبدال المنتجات والمرتجعات وفقاً للسياسات المتبعة. مراقبة الموقع الإلكتروني وتتبع الطلبات لضمان سير العمليات بكفاءة. مراجعة المخزون والكميات المتاحة بشكل دوري. إضافة المنتجات الجديدة على الموقع الإلكتروني وتحديث المعلومات الخاصة بها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال المبيعات أو دور مشابه. خبرة في التعامل مع سياسات الضمان وتسجيل الفواتير واستلام المبالغ. معرفة بطرق الدفع المتوفرة والتعامل معها. خبرة في التحكم بالمواقع الإلكترونية وتتبع الطلبات. القدرة على التعلم السريع واكتساب معرفة عميقة بمنتجات الشركة. مهارات تواصل ممتازة للتعامل مع خدمة العملاء. نوع العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل، ويتطلب التواجد في مقر الشركة بمدينة أحد المسارحة، جازان. بيئة العمل ستعمل ضمن فريق مبيعات ديناميكي في شركة محفوظ المميز الرئيسي للتجارة، حيث تتاح لك الفرصة لتطبيق مهاراتك في بيئة تركز على خدمة العملاء وإدارة المنتجات بكفاءة. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم.

d438844ccf199dce.description: About the Role United Motors Company is seeking an IT Support Specialist to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is responsible for providing Level 1 and Level 2 technical support to employees, ensuring productivity across company devices, Microsoft 365 services, approved software, printers, connectivity, and workplace technology. The specialist manages assigned tickets from acknowledgment to resolution or escalation, maintaining accurate records and supporting employee onboarding and offboarding processes. Key Responsibilities Provide timely Level 1 and Level 2 technical support via Freshservice, telephone, remote-access tools, email, and desk-side assistance. Acknowledge, classify, prioritize, investigate, update, and resolve assigned incidents and service requests within applicable service targets. Maintain ownership of the requester experience, even when tickets are assigned to specialist teams or external vendors. Troubleshoot Windows devices and provide working-level support for macOS, browsers, Microsoft Office applications, printers, scanners, monitors, docking stations, and standard peripherals. Support Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, Office activation, shared mailboxes, distribution lists, and common Microsoft 365 user issues. Prepare, configure, test, and deploy laptops, desktops, all-in-one devices, monitors, phones, and approved accessories. Complete onboarding activities, including hardware allocation, Microsoft 365 setup, software installation, policy synchronization, quality checks, and handover. Process approved transfer, role-change, and offboarding tasks, including access changes, asset return, and data ownership handover. Maintain accurate asset assignment, stock, warranty, configuration, and return records in inventory or ITSM systems. Troubleshoot user-level LAN, Wi-Fi, internet, VPN, printer, and IP telephony connectivity issues. Assist with CCTV, access-control, meeting-room, display, and other site-technology incidents by performing first-line checks and routing specialist work. Monitor the Freshservice queue, respond to users, update tickets, and complete endpoint and onboarding tasks. Support office moves, branch openings, planned changes, scheduled after-hours work, incident escalation, and business continuity activities as required. Required Experience and Capabilities Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in IT support. The role requires individuals who can communicate clearly and professionally with both technical and non-technical users, demonstrating a service-oriented and patient approach, especially under pressure. Collaborative work style with other IT teams and vendors, while respecting access, security, change, and approval controls. This full-time role for a Manager, Exploration & Mining Artificial Intelligence, based in Riyadh, is central to enhancing resource discovery, operational efficiency, and sustainability across Ma'aden's mining operations. Role Purpose and Scope The Manager, Exploration & Mining Artificial Intelligence will lead the identification, development, deployment, and adoption of AI solutions across various stages of exploration and mining. This includes geology, resource modeling, mine planning, drilling and blasting, material movement, fleet optimization, production, and mine safety. The role involves translating operational challenges into scalable AI solutions to deliver measurable and sustainable value. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain a prioritized portfolio of Exploration & Mining AI use cases aligned with business strategy and operational targets. Lead the design, development, testing, deployment, and continuous improvement of AI, machine learning, optimization, computer vision, and geospatial analytics solutions. Partner with exploration, geology, mine planning, technical services, mining operations, maintenance, and safety teams to identify and resolve operational challenges. Coordinate the integration of AI solutions with geoscience platforms, mine planning systems, fleet management systems, and other enterprise applications. Embed AI outputs into exploration workflows, technical services processes, operational practices, and management decision-making. Lead and develop a multidisciplinary team combining AI, data science, geoscience, mining engineering, and operational expertise. Ensure solutions comply with safety, cybersecurity, data governance, model governance, responsible AI, quality, and operational risk requirements. Demonstrated ability to translate operational challenges into scalable AI solutions. Experience in leading the development and deployment of AI, machine learning, optimization, computer vision, and geospatial analytics solutions. Proven track record in driving adoption and value realization of AI solutions within operational environments. Experience in team leadership and capability development. d4af5452e9acf105.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مركز الصحة والسلامة الطبي عن طبيب أسنان عام للانضمام إلى فريقه في المنطقة الشرقية. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة، حيث سيقوم شاغل الوظيفة بتشخيص أمراض الفم والأسنان وتقديم مجموعة واسعة من المعالجات السنية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء الفحص الشامل لأسنان المرضى، وتحديد الصور الشعاعية اللازمة، وتحليلها لتشخيص حالات الفم والأسنان. إعداد خطط العلاج وبرامجها الزمنية بما يتناسب مع حالة كل مريض. تجهيز وتطبيق الحشوات ومعالجة القنوات اللبية للأسنان. تنظيف الأسنان وإزالة الرواسب الكلسية. تحديد احتياجات المريض من التعويضات السنية، وأخذ القياسات اللازمة، ومتابعة تنفيذها وتركيبها وضبطها. فحص اللثة وتشخيص أمراضها ومعالجة التهابات اللثة. إجراء جراحات الفم الصغرى ووصف العلاجات والأدوية المناسبة. تطوير الممارسات المهنية تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل باستمرار لمواكبة أحدث التطورات في مجال طب الأسنان. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة أثناء القيام بمختلف أعمال طب وصحة الأسنان. إدارة الوثائق والتقارير إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بأعمال طب الأسنان. حفظ هذه الوثائق في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال طب الأسنان العام. القدرة على تشخيص أمراض الفم والأسنان بدقة. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل مع المرضى وتقديم الرعاية اللازمة. بيئة العمل يعمل طبيب الأسنان العام ضمن فريق مركز الصحة والسلامة الطبي في المنطقة الشرقية، في بيئة عمل داعمة تركز على تقديم أفضل رعاية صحية للمرضى.

d4d9a96af29609a4.description: Autobia is a Saudi technology company founded in Dammam in 2021, building the ecosystem that supports the growth of the traditional retail sector — its most developed vertical to date being the auto parts market. We Hire Builders We hire builders who see themselves in the decisions, not just the tasks — and right now, we're looking for a Supplier Master Data Specialist to ensure the accuracy and integrity of our supplier pricing data. Advanced Excel proficiency (formulas, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables, data cleansing). Experience with ERP systems and master data / catalog management. Strong analytical skills for detecting price discrepancies and identifying data patterns. High attention to detail and numerical accuracy. d46cbeeb16f985f0.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الأثير للتجارة عن مهندس ميكانيكي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات لمشاريع الهندسة الميكانيكية، بالإضافة إلى تطوير برامج التركيب والتشغيل والصيانة الوقائية للمعدات والتجهيزات الصناعية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية للمشاريع الميكانيكية، بما في ذلك المولدات، التوربينات، وحدات التكييف، المراجل، وشبكات توزيع أنظمة التدفئة والتكييف والتبريد. تطوير خطط وبرامج تجميع وتركيب التجهيزات الميكانيكية للمشاريع الصناعية، وتحديد أنظمة الضبط والتحكم اللازمة. إعداد برامج تشغيل المعدات وبرامج الصيانة الوقائية بناءً على تعليمات الشركات المصنعة، ومتابعة تنفيذ هذه الإجراءات. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل بشكل مستمر ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشاريع الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب التقدم، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية بدقة. معرفة ببرامج تجميع وتركيب وتشغيل التجهيزات الميكانيكية. فهم لبرامج تشغيل المعدات الصناعية والصيانة الوقائية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة الرياض. يعمل المهندس الميكانيكي ضمن فريق متخصص يساهم في تنفيذ مشاريع الشركة بكفاءة. التقديم ندعو المهندسين الميكانيكيين المؤهلين والمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق الأثير للتجارة في الرياض للتقديم على هذا الدور.

d4b749b6996e9f21.description: About the Role Al Omar Holding is seeking an experienced QA/QC Engineer to join its Projects Department in Riyadh, Riyadh Province. This full-time role is essential for ensuring that all construction works adhere to approved standards, specifications, and quality requirements across residential, commercial, and multi-storey building projects. Key Responsibilities Implement the company’s Quality Management System across assigned projects and prepare, update, and monitor the Project Quality Plan. Prepare and review Method Statements and Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs) in coordination with project and technical teams. Conduct daily site inspections and quality walkthroughs to verify compliance with approved drawings, specifications, and workmanship standards. Raise, track, and follow up Inspection Requests, attending inspections with consultants, clients, and subcontractors. Monitor field and laboratory test results and ensure materials are approved before use on site. Inspect structural, architectural, waterproofing, finishing, and MEP-related works. Issue Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) for non-compliant works or materials and follow up on Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA). Prepare weekly and monthly quality reports, maintaining comprehensive records of inspections, quality logs, material approvals, and test reports. Coordinate with Project Managers, Site Engineers, consultants, clients, and subcontractors to resolve quality issues and ensure compliance with quality procedures. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or Architecture. Minimum of 8 years of QA/QC experience in construction projects. Proven experience in villas, residential compounds, multi-storey residential buildings, or similar projects. Strong knowledge of the Saudi Building Code and relevant construction standards. Practical experience in concrete, blockwork, waterproofing, finishing, and MEP inspections. Experience dealing with consultants, clients, subcontractors, and testing laboratories. ISO 9001 Internal Auditor certification is preferred; ISO 9001 Lead Auditor certification is an added advantage. Required Skills Strong ability to read and interpret construction drawings and technical specifications. Experience preparing and reviewing ITPs and Method Statements, and practical experience in NCR and CAPA management. Knowledge of inspection procedures for structural, architectural, waterproofing, finishing, and MEP works. Proficiency in Microsoft Office and AutoCAD, with strong working knowledge of Excel for quality reports and tracking logs. Familiarity with ERP systems, including Odoo, is preferred. Strong communication, coordination, reporting, documentation, and analytical skills. High attention to detail, problem-solving, and root-cause analysis skills. Work Environment and Expectations The role requires the ability to conduct regular site inspections, walk construction sites, and access different work areas within an active construction environment. Candidates should be able to work under pressure, manage multiple project priorities, and demonstrate strong time-management skills. Availability to join within 30 days or less is preferred.

d4c1b800f9c44791.description: الإعلان (جاهز للنشر) مطلوب مندوب مبيعات: عمولة تقارب 8,000 ريال على كل عملية بيع 💰 شركة سعودية في الرياض تبحث عن مندوب مبيعات يبيع منتجًا برمجيًا متخصصًا لأصحاب الشركات وصنّاع القرار. المنتج جاهز ومُجرَّب ويعمل فعليًا عند عملاء، فأنت لا تبيع فكرة، بل تبيع حلًا شغّالًا. كم تكسب؟ عمولة 10% من سعر البيع، وهي تقارب 8,000 ريال على كل عملية. لا يوجد سقف للدخل: عشر عمليات تعني تقريبًا 80,000 ريال عمولة. بعد أول عملية بيع يبدأ راتب شهري ثابت إضافةً إلى العمولة. كيف يبدأ التعاقد؟ الشهر الأول بعمولة فقط، ولا يوجد راتب حتى تتم أول عملية بيع. هذا الشرط معلن من البداية لأن الوظيفة مناسبة لمن يثق بقدرته على البيع. نوفّر لك عرضًا جاهزًا، وعرض تجريبي (Demo)، ومواد تسويقية، ودعمًا مباشرًا من الإدارة في الاجتماعات المهمة. نبحث عن شخص: لديه خبرة في المبيعات (B2B تفضيلًا) أو شبكة علاقات مع أصحاب الأعمال يتقن التواصل والإقناع والمتابعة يعمل بحافز ذاتي ويحب أن يرتبط دخله بإنجازه يتحدث العربية بطلاقة قدم الان, وأجب عن سؤالين: ما أكبر عملية بيع أو صفقة أغلقتها، وكم كانت قيمتها؟ هل سبق أن بعت أو تعاملت مع شركات من قطاع الخدمات (استقدام، عمالة منزلية)؟ وإن لم يكن، فما القطاعات التي تملك فيها علاقات مباشرة مع أصحاب الأعمال؟

d4de8b501596877b.description: About the Role A Prominent Regional Corporate Firm in the Oil & Gas sector is seeking a Finance Manager for a permanent role based in Dammam, Eastern region. Oversee product costing, manufacturing cost analysis, and manage inventory valuation and work-in-progress accounting. The Senior Business Analyst will work closely with Portfolio Management, Trading, Risk, Compliance, and Technology teams. Key Responsibilities Gather, analyze, and translate business requirements into functional and technical specifications. Support and enhance CRD/CRIMS functionalities across Portfolio Management, Trading, Risk, and Compliance. Manage Trade Blotter and end-to-end trade workflows across various markets. Provide support for investment products including Equities, Fixed Income, Derivatives, and Mutual Funds. Work with Manager Workbench, PMAR, Account Groups, IBOR, Investment Compliance, and Corporate Actions. Support risk attribution, scenario analysis, asset allocation, security selection, and cash flow forecasting. Work on integrations with MSCI and other third-party data providers, including identifying and resolving data gaps. Support CRD enhancements, integrations, system testing, regression testing, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT). Collaborate with business, technology, and vendor teams to improve investment management processes. Required Experience and Skills 5-10 years of experience as a Business Analyst. Strong background in Asset Management or Investment Banking. Hands-on expertise with Charles River Development (CRD/CRIMS). Ability to work effectively with diverse teams including Portfolio Management, Trading, Risk, Compliance, and Technology. d4b05a5a61d71b39.job_title: Senior Manager HR Strategy and Project Management
d4b05a5a61d71b39.description: About Red Sea Global Red Sea Global (RSG) is dedicated to positively shaping the places people live, work, and travel, with a commitment to people and the planet. The company's transformative programs contribute to achieving Vision 2030 and aim to lead the world in regenerative tourism. Joining RSG offers an opportunity to be part of this positive change for Saudi Arabia and globally. Role Overview The Senior Manager - HR Strategy and Project Management will be responsible for overseeing the development, governance, and execution of Red Sea Global's HR strategy framework, project portfolio, and divisional planning cycle. This full-time role ensures alignment with corporate objectives and integrated delivery across all HR functions. Key Responsibilities Manage the development and maintenance of RSG's People and HR strategy framework and HR service model, ensuring alignment with corporate strategy and evolving business priorities. Monitor the execution of the HR strategy roadmap, tracking progress, identifying delivery risks, and providing performance updates to senior HR leadership. Drive the governance of strategic HR projects and initiatives, establishing reporting cadences, coordinating cross-functional stakeholders, and ensuring timely delivery. Act as the focal point for HR project governance, maintaining structured delivery frameworks, documentation standards, and stakeholder coordination. Manage the annual business planning cycle for the HR division, coordinating input, consolidating deliverables and budget submissions, and ensuring alignment with RSG's business planning calendar. Develop, cascade, and monitor the HR division's KPIs and objectives in coordination with the Strategy & Performance division. Integrate change management strategies into RSG projects affecting people, overseeing stakeholder engagement, communication planning, and transition support. Develop and maintain the HR shared services delivery model between Group HR and RSG subsidiaries, defining the service catalog, pricing framework, and governance method. Facilitate alignment between corporate strategy and HR deliverables through structured project planning, milestone tracking, and execution reviews. Contribute to enterprise-wide transformation initiatives from an HR strategy perspective, ensuring operational and people impacts are assessed and planned. Support the development and implementation of RSG's Saudization strategy, contributing to workforce localization, upskilling, succession planning, and vocational programs. Support GRC and internal audit processes from a project governance perspective by maintaining structured documentation of HR strategic initiatives and performance reports. Required Experience and Qualifications 5-10 years of relevant professional experience. Demonstrated ability to manage HR strategy frameworks and project portfolios. Experience in monitoring strategy execution and tracking progress against defined milestones. Proficiency in establishing reporting cadences and coordinating cross-functional stakeholders for project delivery. Experience in managing annual business planning cycles and consolidating budget submissions. Familiarity with developing and monitoring KPIs and objectives. Capability to integrate change management strategies into projects and manage people impact. Experience in developing and maintaining shared services delivery models. Ability to contribute to enterprise-wide transformation initiatives and support Saudization strategies. Work Type This is a full-time position. Application Process Candidates interested in this opportunity are encouraged to apply.

d43088483760bfe4.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة هوازن الجزيرة للمقاولات عن مهندس مدني للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى المهندس المدني مسؤولية دراسة المواقع الإنشائية، وإعداد التصاميم والمخططات، والإشراف على تنفيذ المشاريع لضمان مطابقتها للمواصفات والمعايير الهندسية. نظرة عامة على المهام يشمل هذا الدور مجموعة من المهام الهندسية الأساسية التي تضمن سير المشاريع الإنشائية بكفاءة ودقة. من دراسة الجدوى الأولية للموقع إلى الإشراف النهائي على التنفيذ، يساهم المهندس المدني في كل مرحلة من مراحل المشروع لضمان الجودة والالتزام بالمواصفات. المسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة طبوغرافية وجيولوجية الموقع الإنشائي ونتائج اختبار فحص التربة. دراسة المتطلبات والمخططات المعمارية للمشروع. تحديد أعماق التأسيس اللازمة للمشروع وإجراء تحليل إنشائي متكامل لعناصره. إعداد تصاميم المشروع ومتابعة إعداد المخططات الإنشائية وتدقيقها. تدقيق جداول الكميات والمواصفات للمواد الإنشائية. الإشراف على تنفيذ المشروع ومطابقة المواصفات الفنية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية ونسبة تقدمها، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال الهندسة المدنية. فهم عميق لأسس التصميم الإنشائي وتحليل التربة. القدرة على إعداد وتدقيق المخططات وجداول الكميات. مهارات ممتازة في الإشراف على المشاريع وضمان مطابقة المواصفات. نوع الوظيفة والموقع هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. تتطلب الوظيفة التواجد في الموقع والإشراف المباشر على المشاريع. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. نشجع المهندسين المدنيين ذوي الخبرة والكفاءة على التقديم.

This is a full-time, field-oriented position based in Dammam, Eastern Province. The role involves hands-on site work and client interaction. Key Responsibilities Conducting site inspections for fire alarm and firefighting systems. Performing fault diagnosis and troubleshooting. Executing preventive and corrective maintenance tasks. Preparing technical proposals and Bills of Quantities (BOQ). Coordinating with clients from initial complaint resolution to final system testing. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 years of experience in electrical engineering, specifically with fire alarm and firefighting systems. Experience with NFPA standards is preferred. d4cc57eaf9b88c56.description: About Alvarez & Marsal Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm known for its entrepreneurial, action-oriented, and results-driven professionals. The firm adopts a hands-on approach to client problem-solving, aiming to help clients achieve their potential. A&M's culture supports independent thinkers and doers who contribute positively to clients and the industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work, guided by core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity, are central to the employee experience. Role Overview: Director, Infrastructure - Power & Utilities Alvarez & Marsal is seeking a Director, Infrastructure - Power & Utilities, to join its team in Riyadh. This full-time role requires 5-10 years of experience and involves leading the day-to-day delivery of major workstreams or smaller engagements. The Director will serve as the senior client counterpart on the ground, driving project progress and providing direction. Key Responsibilities Lead the daily execution of major workstreams or smaller engagements, acting as the primary client contact. Structure complex problems, define analytical approaches, and guide teams to clear solutions across areas such as capital projects, operational performance, utility transformation, market and regulatory issues, and investment decisions. Manage asset and portfolio work spanning generation, transmission, distribution, renewables, storage, water and desalination, data centers (digital infrastructure), cooling, waste, and integrated utility systems, ensuring the connection between technical performance and economic outcomes is maintained. Develop robust fact bases, business cases, benchmarks, value bridges, and implementation plans that clearly outline financial and operational implications. Translate findings into actionable steps, which may include delivery governance, PMO or control-tower disciplines, operational improvements, contract and claims actions, or value-capture tracking. Maintain close client relationships, lead working sessions and steering meetings, manage difficult conversations effectively, and produce concise materials that clarify decisions and next actions. Identify follow-on needs, develop proposals, create client-specific points of view, and actively contribute to account plans and pursuits to generate new work. Integrate A&M specialists and external experts into projects as needed, ensuring clients receive a unified solution rather than disparate work products. Oversee project quality, scope, schedule, team performance, and engagement economics. Coach Managers and junior team members, and contribute to the ongoing development of the Power & Utilities practice. Experience and Qualifications 5-10 years of relevant professional experience. Demonstrated ability to lead and deliver complex engagements. Experience in capital projects, operational performance, utility transformation, market and regulatory analysis, and investment decisions within the power and utilities sector. Proficiency in building business cases, benchmarks, and implementation plans. Professional Development at A&M Alvarez & Marsal supports employee professional and personal development through a robust performance development process that promotes continuous learning and rewards contributions. The firm offers training and on-the-job learning opportunities to facilitate skill acquisition and career advancement. A&M prioritizes employee well-being, providing benefits and resources to support individual journeys. The firm's culture emphasizes growth opportunities, an entrepreneurial environment, and collaborative engagement.

d411dc5153e2e18f.description: About the Role Saudi Air Navigation Services is seeking a Litigations Section Head to manage and represent the company in all legal cases, disputes, litigations, investigations, and corporate claims. This full-time position is based in Makkah, specifically covering Jeddah and Makkah, and requires providing efficient legal support, interfacing with governmental bodies, and interacting with external lawyers. Role Purpose and Scope The primary purpose of this role is to act as a central point of contact for all legal matters, ensuring compliance with applicable laws and internal policies. The Litigations Section Head will operate within established KPIs, agreed budgets, and adopted policies and procedures, focusing on mitigating legal risks and protecting the company's interests. Key Responsibilities Provide legal revisions and consultations on potential complaints and lawsuits, ensuring legal compliance. Offer legal advice to resolve disputes and mitigate legal risks. Communicate root causes of legal cases to relevant departments to prevent recurrence and enhance legal obligation. Stay updated on applicable laws, regulations, and internal policies. Manage and supervise internal investigations related to malpractice, misconduct, and policy breaches by employees. Provide recommendations for disciplinary actions in cases of misconduct or policy breaches. Manage and supervise observations from Anti-Corruption authorities (*, Nazaha, General Court of Audit). Lead and participate in various committees as instructed by superiors. Supervise and review legal cases handled by external law firms to ensure compliance and coverage of legal elements. Defend and protect company interests in all applicable courts and seek conflict resolution to reduce legal, financial, and reputational losses. Represent the company in front of courts and committees for corporate claims, providing necessary documents and legal memorandums. Coordinate with internal and external parties, collecting relevant information for ongoing lawsuits. Examine grievances and complaints related to lawsuits against the company or its subsidiaries, providing resolutions. Manage claims, attorney letters, and the litigation process, preparing reports and recommendations. Review claims and litigation information for validity and settlement in accordance with company practices. Coordinate with attorney offices for company lawsuits within the Kingdom to protect corporate interests. Receive judicial notifications, attend sessions, and prepare session reports. Submit and follow up on the implementation of judicial rulings. Draft and prepare legal responses and provide relevant documents for lawsuits. Develop and update standard contract templates and processes based on legal regulations. Draft and revise various types of legal documents in Arabic. Monitor day-to-day activities to ensure compliance with stipulated policies and procedures. Contribute to continuous improvement of systems and processes. Participate in on-the-job training, mentoring, and coaching of subordinates. Provide clear direction, prioritize tasks, assign and delegate responsibility, and monitor workflow. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of relevant experience is required for this role. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in the Makkah region, covering operations in Jeddah and Makkah. The role involves promoting a high-performance working environment aligned with Saudi Air Navigation Services' values. Application Process Candidates who meet the qualifications and are interested in this opportunity are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

d4160d537859db3d.description: About the Role Cipla is seeking a Lead Electrical Engineer to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role is crucial for ensuring the timely and efficient execution of both greenfield and brownfield projects, maintaining high standards of safety, quality, and cost-effectiveness for site operations. Key Responsibilities Lead project engineering efforts for pharmaceutical (API) greenfield and brownfield projects, ensuring technical accuracy and quality within the electrical section. Assist in preparing business cases, project charters, and concept notes for users. Develop plant layouts and plan facility requirements, including cost estimations for budgetary proposals and operational costs. Perform engineering calculations such as power consumption, control transformer sizing, and instrument loop impedances. Provide guidelines for the design of control panels, junction boxes, and conduit/wiring systems in accordance with NEC and IEC standards. Ensure all statutory and regulatory approvals are obtained at each project stage. Evaluate consultants and prepare consultancy CERs, along with technical evaluation of vendors to meet Cipla specifications. Prepare URS/RDS, technical specification sheets, terms of reference, layouts, and drawings. Conduct risk assessments in coordination with safety and user departments. Develop project schedules and bar charts, including major milestones. Monitor and track all project activities to ensure adherence to time, cost, and quality standards. Ensure contractors comply with all safety norms during electrical work. Support Electrical and Control Systems Factory Acceptance Tests (FATs/SAT) to ensure compliance with company and industrial standards. Communicate project status to stakeholders in a timely manner and conduct daily progress discussions with contractors. Oversee GMP documentation completion for the engineering scope of work and facilitate project handover to the user. Identify critical spares and manage inventory. Required Qualifications and Experience Proven working experience of 10+ years as a Lead Project Engineer, specifically in Pharmaceutical (API) greenfield and brownfield projects. Detailed knowledge of API Process & Utility Equipment, including Reactors, Centrifuges, Dryers, Isolators, Transformers, DG sets, Boilers, and Chillers, particularly concerning their electrical functions. Strong understanding of the National Electric Code (NEC) and International Electro Technical Commission (IEC) standards. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, focusing on critical project execution within the pharmaceutical industry.

d4bb6f29ba5d2c93.description: About the Role: Project Manager, Pricing & Tendering DSV – Global transport and logistics is seeking a Project Manager, Pricing & Tendering to join its team in the Eastern region, covering Dammam and Al Khobar. This full-time role is responsible for managing pricing, tendering, procurement, and vendor-related activities across various logistics segments, including Air, Ocean, Road, and Project Logistics. The position focuses on developing competitive and commercially viable logistics solutions for both standard freight and complex project cargo requirements. Key Responsibilities Manage pricing activities across Air Freight, Ocean Freight, Road Transport, and Project Logistics. Review and analyze customer RFQs, RFPs, tenders, BOQs, and commercial requirements. Prepare accurate and competitive pricing and commercial submissions within required timelines. Develop complete door-to-door pricing solutions, incorporating freight, transportation, handling, customs-related services, equipment, and other applicable logistics costs. Coordinate with Commercial, Operations, Procurement, and Project teams to develop commercially and operationally feasible solutions. Support pricing and tendering for Project Logistics and complex cargo movements, including heavy lift, ODC/OOG, breakbulk, and general cargo. Source and price specialized transportation and handling solutions, such as heavy-haul transport, cranes, and specialized trailers. Source and develop reliable vendors, subcontractors, carriers, and specialized project logistics service providers. Negotiate competitive rates and commercial terms with airlines, shipping lines, road transporters, and other logistics vendors. Manage vendor relationships to ensure competitive pricing, service reliability, and capacity availability. Required Qualifications and Experience Minimum of 5-10 years of relevant experience within freight forwarding, logistics pricing, tendering, procurement, or project logistics. Strong practical experience in Air and Ocean Freight, with a good understanding of Road Transportation. Demonstrated experience in Project Logistics, particularly heavy lift, ODC/OOG (Out-of-Gauge/Over-Dimensional Cargo), breakbulk, and general cargo. Hands-on experience managing RFQs, RFPs, tenders, and complex pricing requests. Strong experience in procurement, vendor sourcing, vendor development, rate negotiation, and supplier relationship management. Good network and understanding of airlines, shipping lines, transporters, agents, and specialized logistics/service providers. Strong understanding of freight rates, logistics cost structures, routing, equipment requirements, and commercial terms. Skills and Competencies Ability to analyze complex requirements and develop commercially competitive logistics solutions. Strong analytical and numerical skills with advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel. Strong negotiation, communication, and stakeholder-management skills. Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple tenders and pricing requests within tight deadlines. Preferred Experience Candidates with established experience and vendor networks in the Saudi/GCC freight-forwarding and project logistics market are preferred. This includes individuals who have independently handled pricing and procurement for complex project cargo and multimodal logistics solutions. Work Location This position is based in Dammam, Saudi Arabia, and operates on a full-time basis.

Organize, secure, and maintain all files, records, cash, and cash equivalents in accordance with established policies and procedures. Classify, code, and summarize numerical and financial data to compile and maintain financial records using journals, ledgers, and/or computers. Prepare, maintain, and distribute statistical, financial, accounting, auditing, or payroll reports and tables. Complete period-end closing procedures and reports as specified. Prepare, review, reconcile, and issue bills, invoices, and account statements according to company procedures. Operational Compliance and Professional Conduct Adhere to all company policies and procedures. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional. Support the team to achieve common goals and respond appropriately to concerns. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors. Qualifications Candidates should possess 0-1 years of relevant experience in accounting or a related financial field. This position is designated for Saudi Nationals only.

d49432c8845a9dd5.description: About the Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority The Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA) is seeking a Policies & Controls Senior Researcher to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role requires 2-5 years of relevant experience and involves working under minimal supervision to contribute to operational achievements and objectives within a specific functional area. Purpose of the Role The Policies & Controls Senior Researcher is responsible for preparing complex, specialized, or unplanned reports relevant to their field of work. This role operates within established guiding principles and procedures, contributing significantly to the completion of operational milestones and objectives. Key Responsibilities Develop standardized work procedures for identifying and monitoring new or amended national and international regulatory compliance obligations, including legislative, contractual, general system, supreme orders, international agreements, fair obligations, mandatory sector-related rules and standards, and regulatory policies. Coordinate with the Corporate Communication and Awareness Agency regarding new or updated external and internal regulations, bylaws, and requirements through meetings, letters, memos, emails, or other awareness formats. Establish standardized work procedures for impact assessment, updating relevant policies, standards, and procedures, and implementing new or amended compliance duties. Conduct research and benchmark best practices (at least annually) to enhance current practices related to ZATCA's compliance framework and policies for all standardized functional policies and procedures for Governance and Compliance Management. Manage and periodically review (at least annually) the Governance and Compliance Management document library, ensuring the suitability, completeness, and classification of document types, and ensuring quality. Identify gaps and areas for improvement, such as preparing new internal documents for the General Department of Governance and Compliance or reviewing existing documents (*, policies, standards, standardized work procedures), along with necessary action plans. Prepare, review, and periodically update a comprehensive controls framework for risks under the responsibility of the General Department of Governance and Compliance as a second line of defense. Identify compliance control requirements for the first and second lines of defense related to risks within the Governance and Compliance General Department's risk framework. Develop and continuously measure second-line-of-defense controls under the responsibility of Governance and Compliance Management, according to defined key performance indicators. Adhere to all relevant standardized operational policies, processes, and procedures to ensure work is executed correctly and consistently. Assist in resolving escalated issues and provide necessary support to less experienced teams to ensure efficient work execution. Escalate complex issues to the appropriate personnel to ensure proper and correct resolution of issues. Perform other duties as required by business needs. Stay updated on the latest trends and developments in policy and controls design, implementation, and monitoring, including international best practices, to ensure the alignment and applicability of compliance-related processes and procedures. Support in identifying channels, systems, and tools for monitoring regulatory requirements. Monitor regulatory requirements and inform relevant stakeholders of any changes as needed. Participate in determining the impact of new or updated regulatory requirements on existing policies, controls, and other documents owned by the General Department of Governance and Compliance. Participate in designing controls for the first and second lines of defense within the Authority, detailing control owners, control frequency, and other relevant aspects. Support in developing supporting documents to facilitate control implementation and testing, and update the Authority's control set by adding all developed or updated controls. Participate in developing policies, standards, requirements, and standardized work procedures within the General Department of Governance and Compliance document library. Train less experienced employees on various functional activities to ensure knowledge transfer, when applicable. Provide clear guidance, prioritize tasks, assign and delegate responsibility, and monitor the progress of subordinates or less experienced employees. Support employees or direct subordinates in executing their tasks according to established processes and policies. Qualifications and Requirements Bachelor's degree in Legal Studies, Business Administration, or an equivalent field. A minimum of 2 years of experience in a relevant field, with 2-5 years preferred. Work Type This is a full-time position based in Riyadh. Application Process Candidates who meet the qualifications are encouraged to apply.

d4b8ad01aad2408a.description: About the Role Ninja is seeking an Onboarding Specialist to join its team in Riyadh, Riyadh Province. This full-time role involves supporting the Human Resources department in delivering a smooth and efficient onboarding experience for new employees. The specialist will coordinate various onboarding activities and ensure new hires are well-prepared for their integration into the organization. Role Overview The Onboarding Specialist serves as a key contact for new employees during their initial transition. This position requires close collaboration with multiple departments to ensure all necessary arrangements are in place before an employee's start date. The role focuses on maintaining comprehensive onboarding documentation and supporting the overall new hire experience. Key Responsibilities Coordinate the entire onboarding process for new employees, from offer acceptance through initial integration. Act as the primary HR contact for new employees during their onboarding period, providing support throughout their transition. Coordinate and support new employee orientation sessions, including induction schedules and providing required onboarding information. Collaborate with Talent Acquisition, HR Operations, Government Relations, IT, Administration, and hiring managers to ensure onboarding readiness. Follow up on system access, equipment, workstations, email accounts, documentation, and other requirements before the employee's joining date. Collect, review, and maintain accurate onboarding documentation and employee records in coordination with HR Operations. Monitor onboarding checklists and follow up on outstanding onboarding activities and requirements. Follow up with new employees during their initial employment period and support probation-related activities with hiring managers and HR Operations. Address onboarding-related inquiries and escalate issues to the relevant HR team when necessary. Gather onboarding feedback and support initiatives aimed at improving the onboarding process and overall employee experience. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 year of relevant experience. Work Type This is a full-time position based in Riyadh. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

d4c3d9259af8baa2.description: About the Tamheer Program The Tamheer program is an on-the-job training initiative for Saudi graduates, designed to provide valuable experience and skills. It aims to prepare bachelor's degree holders for full-time employment by offering training opportunities at international organizations and prominent companies. This program is specifically for graduates who have not been employed in the last six months. HR Officer Opportunity National Medical Care is seeking fresh graduates to join the Human Resources Department as an HR Officer through the Tamheer program. Identify and generate new sales leads through outreach, referrals, networking, databases, and other sales channels. Conduct outbound calls, emails, and follow-ups with prospective clients to generate and convert opportunities. Understand client requirements and recommend appropriate training programs and certification pathways. Present course and certification information clearly, including benefits, requirements, schedules, and pricing. Prepare and share quotations, proposals, and relevant sales materials with prospective clients. Follow up consistently with leads and prospects throughout the sales cycle. Maintain regular communication with clients to identify additional training and development needs. Support repeat business, renewals, and cross-selling opportunities across the company’s portfolio. d41d37b50f829fcc.description:  معرفة التاريخ الصحي والنفسي للمستفيد ومتابعة أي تطور أو ما يستجد عليه.  استلام المستفيدين بالموعد المحدد.  فحص المستفيد بداية اليوم والتأكد من سالمته ولياقته والتبليغ الفوري عن أي طارئ.  الالتزام بموعد الحلقة وجدول الحلقة يوميا مع استخدام وسائل الدعم البصري.  تدريب المستفيد على المجالات الحركية والاستقلاليه.  اتباع الطرق التربوية في التعزيز وتعديل السلوك.  تطبيق الجدول البصري.  تدريب المستفيد على المهارات الاستقلاليه كـ قضاء الحاجة وتناول الوجبة وغيرها من المهارات الاستقلاليه.  المحافظة على الوسائل والادوات وتنظيم البيئة الصفية.  اغلاق الاضاءة والتكييف وترتيب الفصل وإعادة الادوات وتسليم مفتاح المهارات نهاية الدوام.  تسليم المستفيد مرتبا نهاية البرنامج مع جميع اغراضه للمناوب/ة أو مشرف/ة الباص يدا بيد.  متابعة أداء المستفيدين وكتابة الملاحظات وتبليغ الاداره الفنية حول أي طارئ أو تغيرات تخص المستفيد.  التبليغ عند وجود أي عطل او عطب أو مهام مطلوبة.  المساهمة بإعداد الانشطه المصاحبة للبرنامج )لعب منظم / فنية( مع الاخصائي/ة.  المساهمة في المناسبات العامة بالافكار والمشاركة لدمج المستفيد بالمجتمع.  المساهمة في إعداد الحفل الختامي.  المساهمة في إعداد برنامج استقبال المستفيدين.  تدريب المستفيدين في حال غياب الاخصائي/ة مع رصد ما تم التدريب عليه بالنظام.  إعداد وسائل تدريبية.  المساعدة بـ تجهيز الجلسة التدريبية الاخصائي/ة. الكفاءات والمهارات المهارات الشخصية:  القدرة على إدارة البيئة الصفية والتوجيه بفعالية.  مهارات حل المشاكل واتخاذ القرارات باستشارة المشرف/ة.  مهارات تنظيمية قوية وإدارة الوقت.  القدرة على العمل تحت الضغط والتعامل مع التحديات الميدانية. الخبرات العملية: المهارات التقنية  إجادة استخدام برامج الكمبيوتر والتطبيقات التقنية. التوصيف الوظيفي المهارات التواصلية  العمل الجماعي وتبادل المعلومات بفعالية.  التنسيق مع المشرف/ة لطلب الدعم والتوجيه.  الاتزام التام بتعليمات وتوجيهات العمل.

d4308da4ec5cd212.description: استقبال الزوار والعملاء والرد على الاتصالات الهاتفية وتنظيم المواعيد وتقديم الدعم الإداري، بما يضمن حسن سير العمل وتولد انطباع مهني إيجابي عن المركز. المهام والمسئوليات: المهام والمسئوليات الرئيسية: استقبال الزوار والترحيب بهم بما يليق بالمظهر العام للمركز. مسؤولية أبواب المركز من خلال فتحها وإقفالها طوال وقت العمل. تسجيل واستلام الأطفال من أولياء الأمور أثناء خروج ودخول المستفيدين. حسن التصرف في المواقف الطارئة. الاستماع بعناية للزوار لضمان تقديم الخدمة المناسبة. التقيد بالزي الرسمي. الالتزام بسرية المعلومات وحمايتها من أي تسريب. تسويق الخدمات للعملاء. خدمة العملاء وأمين الصندوق: متابعة عملية التمويل للعملاء و التوثيق في النماذج المخصصة. التواصل وتأكيد حجز المواعيد. تحديث بيانات العملاء الزائرين في النماذج المخصصة. التنسيق مع الأقسام الإدارية الأخرى في الفرع. متابعة رضا العملاء. متابعة عملاء التأمين وتزويدهم بالإفادات. متابعة حضور العملاء وعدد الجلسات وتوقيع النماذج المعتمدة. إدخال اسم العميل للجلسات التعويضية على نظام زيبرا بوكس. حصر الفواتير على سدايا. متابعة إجراءات الدفع مع الأهل على نظام وتطبيقات الدفع والفواتير الكترونياً و يدوياً. التسجيل في كشف الخصومات للفرع. متابعة تسوية العهدة كل يوم 15 من كل شهر وترتيب ملف الفواتير. عمل مراجعة ورفع أموال لمحاسب الفرع. أي مهام أخرى توكل إليها من قبل الرئيس المباشر أو مهام تقتضيها حاجة العمل. الكفاءات والمهارات: المؤهلات العلمية: شهادة الثانوية العامة كحد أدنى، ويفضل دبلوم إداري أو ما يعادله. المهارات الشخصية: مهارات التواصل وخدمة العملاء. اللباقة وحسن التعامل. التنظيم والدقة في العمل. القدرة على multitasking وإدارة عدة مهام. سرعة الاستجابة وحل المشكلات البسيطة. الخبرات العملية: خبرة سابقة في مجال الاستقبال أو خدمة العملاء (يفضل). المهارات التواصلية: مهارات ممتازة في القيادة والتوجيه والتواصل الفعال. إجادة استخدام الحاسب الآلي وبرامج Microsoft Office. مهارات تواصل ممتازة وحسن المظهر والسلوك المهني. القدرة على تنظيم الوقت والعمل تحت الضغط.

Key Responsibilities: Manage and lead a team of infrastructure engineers and support staff, providing guidance and mentorship. d4cef6b2b5d2295d.description: Job Purpose: To supervise and coordinate daily maintenance activities, ensuring that all systems and facilities operate efficiently and safely. The role includes overseeing technicians, managing work schedules, handling emergency repairs, and coordinating with suppliers for materials and services. Key Responsibilities: Supervise the maintenance team and assign tasks according to work priorities and staff availability. Implement and monitor preventive and corrective maintenance schedules for electrical, plumbing, HVAC, and other systems. Respond quickly to emergency issues and coordinate fast, effective solutions. Ensure maintenance work meets quality, efficiency, and safety standards. Manage inventory of tools, spare parts, and materials; request purchases when needed. Maintain accurate records and generate regular reports on maintenance activities and equipment status. Liaise with other departments to plan maintenance with minimal disruption to operations. Oversee relationships with suppliers and service providers; coordinate external maintenance or repair jobs as needed. Maintain up-to-date knowledge of market prices for electrical and plumbing materials and spare parts. Review and compare supplier quotations to assist in cost-effective purchasing decisions. Negotiate pricing and terms with vendors to obtain competitive rates. Monitor technician performance and provide training and support to enhance skills and productivity. Enforce compliance with safety procedures and company policies during all maintenance work. Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 3–5 years of experience in maintenance, with at least 1 year in a supervisory role. Strong knowledge of electrical, plumbing, and mechanical systems. Familiarity with maintenance software (e.g., CMMS) is an advantage. Solid understanding of local supplier networks and market pricing for common materials. Strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills. Ability to read technical drawings and troubleshoot issues. Commitment to workplace safety and preventive maintenance practices.
